priorityList: Cast Reaver's Glaive whenever it is available to apply Reaver's Mark and trigger buffs.
During the Fel-Scarred Demonsurge window (after Eye Beam/Meta), prioritize empowered Death Sweep and Annihilation.
Cast Essence Break only if Fury is available and Death Sweep is ready or will be ready within 1 GCD.
During the Essence Break window, prioritize Death Sweep followed by Annihilation.
Cast Eye Beam on cooldown to trigger Demonic form and Fel-Scarred procs, ensuring Blade Dance is already on cooldown.
Cast Death Sweep (or Blade Dance) on cooldown.
Use Metamorphosis as your primary offensive cooldown, ideally after your initial Eye Beam/Demonsurge window ends.
Cast The Hunt on cooldown, ideally when not in the middle of a Reaver's Glaive or Essence Break window.
Use Vengeful Retreat to trigger Initiative or Inertia buffs before Eye Beam or high-damage sequences.
Cast Felblade if Fury is low (below 40) or to generate Fury when major abilities are on cooldown.
Cast Immolation Aura on cooldown for Fury generation and consistent damage.
Cast Annihilation (while in Meta) or Chaos Strike (while out of Meta) to spend excess Fury and avoid capping.
Cast Fel Rush as a filler if Inertia is talented and the trigger buff is active.
Cast Throw Glaive as a filler if you have the Soulscar talent and no other priority actions are available.
Use Arcane Torrent if you are low on Fury and in range of the target.
